question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**realise**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a recurring dream where the narrator suddenly becomes aware of a class they forgot to attend.
 
• "**Realise**" means to become aware of or understand something. (समझना या महसूस करना)
 
 
• Example: She suddenly realised she had left her phone at home.
 
 
 
• The word perfectly fits the context as the narrator becomes aware of the missed class in the dream.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Praise** (प्रशंसा): To express admiration or approval. Does not fit the context of becoming aware in the passage.

 
 
• Example: The teacher praised the students for their excellent performance.
 
 
 
• **Offer** (प्रस्ताव करना): To present something for acceptance or rejection, which does not align with the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: He offered his seat to the elderly woman on the bus.
 
 
 
• **Promise** (वादा): A declaration that one will do or refrain from doing something. Does not match the context of the passage.
 
 
• Example: She made a promise to visit her grandparents every weekend.
